name: Wikipedia Birth Chart Collection — Candidacy
description: Birth data extracted from Wikipedia infoboxes for notable individuals. Contains 15 manually curated records as a candidacy proof-of-concept demonstrating the schema, coverage, and quality approach. v1.0.0 target: 10,000+ records via automated extraction pipeline.
source_description: Manually curated from Wikipedia infoboxes. Each record verified against Wikidata for cross-reference. Coordinates geocoded from birthplace. Timezone assigned from IANA tzdata via coordinates.
known_limitations: Candidacy version — 15 records only; not statistically significant
Birth times mostly unknown (Wikipedia infoboxes rarely include birth time)
Geographic and demographic bias toward Western notable figures
Notability bias — only individuals with Wikipedia articles included
license_restrictions: Attribution required when redistributing or adapting
intended_use: Research on notable individuals, career trajectory, longevity studies

extraction_specification.rate_limiting: respect Wikipedia API guidelines: 200 req/s for bots, 1 req/s for unregistered
extraction_specification.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, article title, Wikipedia, The Free Encyclopedia
